_📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Do not describe the generated graph as a real fleet shape.**

The verifier models the fleet and compares recomputed metrics with measured targets; it does not reproduce or benchmark an actual production fleet. Use “modeled fleet shape” to keep the claim precise.

As per coding guidelines, documentation must use plain technical prose and avoid unsupported claims.





<details>
<summary>Proposed wording</summary>

```diff
-- the core operations and the gate bench run at a real fleet's shape
+- the core operations and the gate bench run at the modeled fleet shape
```
</details>

([FLEET.md](FLEET.md), `bench/fleet-shape.json`)
